identity.title: Repeated Evidence-Backed Alpha Discovery, Probability, Net Edge and Outcome Learning
identity.objective: Implement repeatable public-source-backed candidate discovery, one real semantically compatible independent event probability method, net executable EV ranking, append-only shadow decisions and outcome/learning feedback; no credential, account, scheduler, execution or live authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert exactly six tracked additive alpha shadow files; canonical Alpha/strategy/Hermes stores, CC canary, paper/live, risk and policies remain untouched; shadow scratch output remains outside repository.

api_matrix.reason: One additive foreground CLI coordinates existing native research and public-source logic without changing execution or source contracts.

items.before: Existing ALPHA-03A is finite offline proof and does not routinely obtain real public market candidates or source-backed probability estimates.
items.after: Repeatable bounded observed-universe scan + one genuine event-specific independent forecast method + scoring + later outcome feedback.
items.compatibility_requirement: Must reuse ALPHA-02, WP172 and existing public adapters; never touch protected paths.

items.before: No one-loop record of actual independent p, fill-aware candidate edge and time-later resolution.
items.after: One replay-verifiable attempt / prediction / resolution record per occurrence, outside repository.
items.compatibility_requirement: Only public source and genuine separately available resolutions; historical/replay not current venue.

items.before: Current roadmap reserves outcome learning but native repeated empirical improvement has not been demonstrated.
items.after: Propose one bounded parameter/research selection revision, if enough OOS evidence exists.
items.compatibility_requirement: No modification of original forecasts, risk, production stores or automatic adoption.

semantic_fields.reason: Ten complete bounded behaviors establish source realism, probability, net edge, repeated attempts, paper/resolution feedback, measured improvements and non-economic safety.
